title: Reconcile federation settling status across plural snapshots and admission helpers
outcome: The documented settling contract accurately describes singular/plural snapshot and new-admission helpers, with intentional client retry semantics.
acceptance: Either helpers consistently classify an intact-authority temporary durability hold as 423, or documentation explicitly describes and justifies the remaining 409 split.
Tests cover plural snapshots and admission during a hold and continuity loss, preserving all stale-authority and admission fences and existing client recovery semantics.
